svg.title: Contact sheet: GNSS measurements, positioning and integrity
svg.desc: One tile per scenario kind of the family GNSS measurements, positioning and integrity, each the chart the engine writes for a bundled example of that kind, labelled with the kind and its ledger status: integrity MODELLED 6 · VALIDATED 4; gnss-sim VALIDATED; pvt MODELLED; araim-reference-check VALIDATED; space-weather MODELLED; realtime-frame-eop MODELLED 1 · VALIDATED 2. Modelled results from stated inputs, not measurements. Advisory: not type-approved navigation equipment.
